_comment: MOTH v1.0.0 — operator-tunable config. All thresholds are conservative defaults.
_min_funding_annualized_pct_note: Minimum annualized funding % to consider. 50% = extreme crowding. Raise to 80+ for highest-conviction only.
_min_persistence_hours_note: Consecutive hours the funding must have been elevated before entry. Prevents one-tick spikes.
_min_oi_usd_note: Minimum open interest in USD. Below this, liquidity risk on exit is too high.
_min_days_to_expiry_note: Minimum days remaining before expiry to allow new entry. Never enter within 24h of resolution.
_force_close_hours_note: Hard gate: producer stops emitting signals for tickers within this many hours of expiry. The operator should also manually close any open positions at this threshold.
_leverage_note: Max 2x — hard cap. Binary resolution means full loss is possible. Do NOT increase.

expiry_registry._note: Populate with known outcome ticker expiry timestamps (Unix seconds). Example:

_expiry_registry_howto: The Hyperliquid API does not yet surface expiry dates in market_list_instruments for outcome tickers. Populate this registry manually from Hyperliquid docs or the prediction market interface. Keys = exact ticker names, values = Unix timestamp of resolution. Leave empty to trade all detected outcome tickers with unknown expiry (hours_to_expiry = -1.0, LLM gate will approve cautiously).
